name: luacheck
description: Comprehensive Lua static analyzer and linter detecting undefined globals, unused variables, and code quality issues

luacheck.description: Static analyzer and linter for Lua detecting globals, unused variables, unreachable code, and style issues
luacheck.usage:
luacheck src/ # Lint entire directory
luacheck script.lua # Lint single file
luacheck --globals myGlobal script.lua # Allow specific globals
luacheck --std=lua51+busted tests/ # Set standard library
luacheck --formatter=plain src/ # Change output format
luacheck --no-unused-args module.lua # Disable unused arg warnings
